packageRules.description: The chart's own image: tag is empty on purpose (defaults to appVersion, set by the release tag). Never pin or bump it.
Our own composite actions are consumed from main by design; a digest pin would turn every commit there into a PR here.
tbot must not run newer than the Teleport proxy it joins (curl -s https://teleport.maestra.io/webapi/find | jq .server_version). Raise the ceiling after the proxy upgrade.
One PR for all Go module minors; the kubernetes monorepo keeps its own group from config:recommended.
